messages:
maria (sec): Need a compact SIEM snapshot request template for IR/vuln triage. Must include who unwraps KMS, snapshot TTL, ephemeral RBAC duration, chain-of-custody, and PII flag. pinging @dina @jon.

dina (oncall): From last incident: default TTL 48h, infra does unwrap via kms-proxy, ephemeral analyst role, log audit + ticket.

jon (infra): 48h default is fine. Legal holds can extend to 7d with approvals. Never give direct CMK decrypt to people  use KMS proxy + audit.

kms-bot: KMS unwraps require justification, ticket_id, and approver; events logged to audit.kms.

maria (sec): Drop a copy/paste request body we can add to runbook?

eli (sre): Use this minimal template:

```
request: SIEM-SNAP-FOR-INC-2026
ttl: 48h
datasets: auth-logs, proxy
purpose: vuln-triage
pii_yn: no
kms_unwrap: security-kms-proxy
ephemeral_role: ephemeral/forensics-INC-2026 (expires=48h)
approver: sec_oncall
justification: suspected credential compromise
ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026
chain_of_custody: ticket + snapshot-id + action-log
export_policy: no external transfer; presigned URL expiry=1h for internal share
scrub: auth-pii-minimize (if pii_yn=yes)
```

maria (sec): Sam, legal okay with PII flag and extend rules?

sam (legal): Yes. If PII_YN=yes require scrub-first or written sign-off. For TTL>48h need product + legal approval in ticket (max 7d).

jon (infra): Runbook steps: infra job creates snapshot, tags with ticket+retention, optionally runs scrubber, re-wraps artifact with CMK to destination bucket, creates ephemeral role enforced by OPA, and calls kms-proxy for unwrap. All actions logged.

dina (oncall): Presigned URL lifetime must be 1h. Longer sharing requires ticket update and approvals.

maria (sec): Great, I'll update the runbook with this template and workflow. Thanks! :thumbsup:
